comment: cmd.c dokeylist() 2901 and 2966-2980, spkey_name() for NHKF_COUNT: with number_pad on, BIND=^C:count puts the count prefix on Ctrl-C, which dokeylist() reserves as the interrupt key before classifying special keys, so spkey_gap is set and the 'Full list of keyboard commands' (? j) lists '[count]' among the keyless special key commands. ESC closes the list.
